identity.platform_motto: Your college gets you a degree. Clstr gets you a city.
identity.community_motto: Find your team. Vizag is the campus.
identity.definition: A verified, cross-college student community for Visakhapatnam, built on two equal pillars: Collaborate (find people who complement your skills) and Socialize (meet people outside your own campus).
what_we_are_not: Not a placement agency / job board
identity.expansion_sequencing: Vizag first (proven small before scaled) -> Andhra Pradesh (12-18 months) -> India (multi-year with event licensing model).

competitor_analysis.scale: 1.2M+ students reached, Collective Artists Network backed
competitor_analysis.lack_in_vizag: Locally generic; needs celebrity budget; not Vizag-native
Domain-specific, not a persistent social+collab identity community
Single-domain (tech/business only), not cross-skill, zero social space

competitor_analysis.scale: Vizag-native, 200k+ followers, AU Mega Walk-In Drives
competitor_analysis.lack_in_vizag: Pure job listing aggregator; no community, no belonging mechanic, no cross-college identity
Anonymous, single-college, zero real-world connection or execution

competitive_landscape_and_moat.moat: Hyper-local Vizag-first identity combined with serving the ~2/3 of students who are socially-driven first, not just the 1/3 collab-hungry segment. Real identity, cross-campus leverage, and physical+digital integration.

target_audience_segments.collab_hungry_profiles: Trapped coders needing designers, designers needing credit, solo creators, student founders running small businesses (thrift, baking, design, trading).
target_audience_segments.socially_hungry_profiles: Anxious freshers, commuter students, outstation/non-local students adjusting to Vizag, women navigating hostel curfews seeking safe community, sports/fitness enthusiasts.
target_audience_segments.career_skeptical_profiles: Final-years stressed about placements, skeptics burned by dead WhatsApp groups needing proof of real outcomes.

monetization_and_ethics.core_rule: NEVER sell student data or use per-lead contact bounty models. Sponsors pay for visibility, stalls, and stage presence only.

sponsorship_tiers.title_sponsor: Rs 15,000 - Rs 50,000 / event (logo, stage slot, social posts)
sponsorship_tiers.community_partner_annual: Rs 50,000 - Rs 1,00,000 / year (all 12 events, website branding)
sponsorship_tiers.in_kind_sponsor: Rs 0 cash (covers food, venue, printing, or photography)
